name: Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Atlas — Canonical Work Order
purpose: Operational TODO, dependency order and project orientation for maintaining, simplifying, validating and expanding the atlas. Future repository scans should read this file before new work begins.

project_introduction.mission: Map Tim Dooley, the Potato of Life, Potatoism, and the wider field of people, dwellers, dogs, cult and culture, places, institutions, ideas, events, symbols and systems that become meaningful in relation to them.
project_introduction.central_difficulty: Tim Dooley and the Potato are highly relational. A useful map therefore cannot be reduced to biographies or isolated properties; it must map the relationships through which the subject becomes legible.
project_introduction.working_hypothesis: The Potato of Life is treated as a structural object whose attributed properties may make it useful for comparing matter and spirit, inside and outside, root and fruit, boundary and interface, scale and dimension. The project investigates geometry, invariants, transformations and recurring structures without assuming in advance what they prove.
project_introduction.goal: Build a navigable repository in which the highest-value information can be reached from multiple directions, while preserving the distinction between evidence, history, calculation, hypothesis, metaphor and project-defined interpretation.
project_introduction.method: Map first; connect second; interpret third.

core_questions: What is Tim Dooley in the project's different senses?
What is a potato as an observable biological/material object?
What properties have historically been attributed to potatoes or to analogous objects?
What is the Potato of Life and how are its properties, geometry and relationships defined?
How do chariot, angel, messenger, ladder, door, wedge, mandorla and Jesus Door fit into the Potatoism architecture?
How does the Potato of Life's vesica-piscis geometry relate the mandorla, Door, Son, Father, Axis, Ladder and Tree?
Which dimensions, scales, symmetries, invariants and transformations recur?
Which people, dwellers, dogs, groups, cultures, institutions, places, objects, texts and events connect to the map?
Which relationships are observed, sourced, historical, calculated, project-defined or hypothetical?
What structure becomes visible when the map is sufficiently connected?
core_rule: Do not expand a broken or duplicated layer. Audit first, simplify second, validate third, then add sourced data and relationships.
working_loop: establish canonical owners and remove unnecessary paths
update views and manifests from canonical data
only then move to the next expansion area

gates.name: Repository snapshot
gates.rule: Inspect tree, routes, manifests, schemas, data counts and recent changes before editing.

gates.name: Bug gate
gates.rule: Broken JSON, links, JavaScript, files, references and routes outrank enrichment.

gates.name: Duplication gate
gates.rule: Every new dataset must be checked against existing canonical owners; merge, redirect or retire unnecessary duplicates.

gates.name: Architecture gate
gates.rule: Every dataset has one owner, stable schema, purpose and consumer.

gates.name: Evidence gate
gates.rule: Empirical and historical claims require appropriate provenance; project-defined symbolism must be labelled as such.

gates.name: Identity gate
gates.rule: Entities and relationships resolve to canonical IDs; aliases are not duplicate entities.

gates.name: Validation gate
gates.rule: Run structural, semantic, reference, duplicate and completeness checks before publishing counts.

gates.name: View gate
gates.rule: Website pages are views over canonical data, not shadow databases.

gates.name: Release gate
gates.rule: Update manifests and counts only after underlying data and integrity checks pass.

phases.name: Full repository audit
tasks: find stale counts and false completeness claims
find unused files and unreachable routes
record bugs before adding new layers

phases.name: Fix bugs and broken paths
tasks: make core pages render real content

phases.name: Simplify and consolidate
tasks: choose one canonical owner per dataset
migrate consumers before retiring legacy files
prefer one atlas with many views

phases.name: Build real country layer
tasks: do not call a country enriched until validated evidence exists

phases.name: Build religion and belief as a real layer
tasks: keep Potatoism project-defined contemporary material separate from empirical demographic claims

phases.name: Fully map the Potato and Potato of Life
tasks: map inside/outside, root/fruit, threshold, cycle and scale relations
map project-defined correspondences: chariot, angel, messenger, vessel, ladder, door and tree
define Potato of Life vesica-piscis geometry
define mandorla as the overlap/interface region
define Door in the wedge as project geometry
map Jesus Door as the Son-as-Door project-theological symbol
connect Potato → Door → mandorla → Son → Father → Axis → Ladder → Tree
research independent historical/art/religious sources for analogous motifs
compare the same relational grammar across other objects and systems

phases.name: Expand philosophy, mythology and Potatoism
tasks: label project-defined and interpretive material clearly

phases.name: Add scenario and policy layers
tasks: keep hypothetical material separate from observations

phases.name: Simplify interface around finished data model

priority_rule: Critical gates and bugs outrank new data. Structural simplification outranks enrichment. Evidence-backed core data outranks decorative expansion. New layers are added only when their canonical owner, evidence model, relationships and consumer are clear.
expansion_rule: Before adding a new file, ask whether an existing canonical dataset can hold the information. If yes, extend it rather than creating another parallel dataset.
definition_of_done: A phase is done only when its data exists, consumers work, references resolve, provenance is adequate, duplicates are controlled, manifests are accurate and the integrity checker passes.
